interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, ADA-compliant walking path.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised curb to prevent vehicles from parking on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to provide physical separation between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to at least 6 feet to meet modern accessibility standards and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic while improving the environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures designed to illuminate the sidewalk specifically, enhancing safety and visibility after dark.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossings
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and signage to provide safe crossing opportunities on this long block.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a raised median refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to provide space for a wider sidewalk buffer or a protected bike lane.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the wide curb cut to the minimum width necessary for vehicle access to reduce the pedestrian conflict zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.
